content.title: Mandatory Security Audit for All Protocol Changes
content.description: This proposal establishes mandatory security requirements for all future protocol changes. Requirements: 1) All code changes must pass audit by 2 independent security firms, 2) 30-day public review period before any deployment, 3) Bug bounty program with $1M allocation, 4) Formal verification required for critical financial logic, 5) Incident response team with 24/7 coverage. No exceptions for 'urgent' changes - security is never optional.

title: Mandatory Security Audit for All Protocol Changes
summary: Require security audits and formal verification for all changes
